target.statement: SilIF (α=1.0) achieves AUC-PR 0.1339 ± 0.014 on IEEE-CIS, vs plain Isolation Forest 0.1259 ± 0.010 (mean over 5 seeds)
target.table_ref: Table II (also Table IV paired comparison)

compute.basis: Paper claims ~60s/seed for SilIF on 1.85M rows on a laptop CPU; IEEE-CIS is 590K rows with 100 trees, so 5 seeds plus preprocessing and Kaggle download should fit in ~1-1.5h of command time, assuming the released code runs.

blockers: IEEE-CIS data requires a Kaggle account and accepting competition rules (not a plain free download)
Code repo may be incomplete or not match the paper's exact preprocessing/feature set (C1, C2, C13, C14, card1 filtering to >=5 transactions)
Exact AUC-PR numbers depend on undocumented details (random seeds, sklearn version, MiniBatchKMeans settings)
title: SilIF: Silhouette-Augmented Isolation Forest for Unsupervised Transaction Fraud Detection
